author: reek
body: Proves the sim-loop wiring for library knowledge: a draw consumes the top of an agent's library knowledge, but only when a card is actually drawn. The turn loop reads each player's library size before and after the draw step and feeds both to lib-after-draw; a smaller after means the known top card left, so the window shifts up. This is the plumbing that lets scry/brainstorm knowledge (once those cards exist) survive exactly until the card is drawn.
